text:
Lena (AE): FYI 10x POC with TrustBank is failing their strict validator intermittently on our fn_call payload. CISO asking for a mitigation + KMS/network assurance.

Omar (SE): Can you paste the raw failing fragment and headers?

Lena (AE): They provided a scrubbed proxy log: 

```\n2026-10-05T13:08:11Z upstream 422 validation_error\nx-req=tb-331 trace=tb-xx-331 body=\"{\\\"fn_call\\\":\\\"{\\\\\\\"name\\\\\\\":\\\\\\\"submitKYC\\\\\\\",\\\\\\\"arguments\\\\\\\":\\\\\\\"{\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"user\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\":\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"{\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"id\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\":\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"u-331\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"}\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"}\\\\\\\"}\\\"}\"\n```

Priya (ML Eng): Looks like nested quoting: `arguments` is a quoted string containing JSON. If their validator expects an object it fails. Pattern matches previous issues when `json_mode` + `function_call=auto` + streaming are used.

Ben (Infra): Also they show retries in logs which bumps error volume. We need their X-Request-ID to correlate our gateway trace. I can stage a tenant-scoped sanitizer to unescape top-level quoted JSON in fn_call.arguments while engineering digs in. That requires an audit note though.

Omar (SE): Short unblock suggestions for TrustBank (ordered): 1) Call with `function_call: \"explicit\"` + `json_mode: \"relaxed\"` temporarily; 2) Disable streaming for POC; 3) We enable a per-tenant sanitizer to unescape quoted JSON in `fn_call.arguments`.

Lena (AE): They asked about Dedicated: per-tenant KMS and static egress. Need a one-paragraph security blurb for CISO now.

Priya (ML Eng): Short security note: we integrate with AWS KMS and GCP KMS for hosted; Dedicated supports HSM-backed keys and per-tenant key control. Control-plane logs redact request bodies by default; customers may opt into encrypted debug capture with explicit consent. I'll DM the one-pager.

Ben (Infra): Rolling the sanitizer to staging for tenant trustbank-331 (stage -> canary). ops-bot: create trace link.

support-bot: Trace created https://traces.internal/tb-xx-331. Staging sanitizer rule id=stg-331 created.

Omar (SE): We'll ask TrustBank to retest with X-Request-ID header and to try `function_call: explicit` + non-streaming. If staging sanitizer removes failures we'll propose a limited prod hotfix and ship a runtime patch to ensure `arguments` are emitted as structured tokens when `json_mode` is true. INF-9120 created.

Lena (AE): They've scheduled a retest at 2pm local. I told them we'll have a staging mitigation and a short security blurb. Will update with results.

Priya (ML Eng): Root cause hypothesis: streaming flush + auto function calling can cause serializer to emit stringified arguments for safety mid-stream. Fix: runtime guard prefer structured tokens for `arguments` when `json_mode` is enabled. INF-9120 tracks tests and patch.

Ben (Infra): Monitoring staging now for unescape hits and false positives. Rolling canary to 5% traffic after green. Legal looped in for payload mutation sign-off.

Lena (AE): TrustBank retested and report validation errors dropped to zero in staging. CISO wants a short risk acceptance paragraph.

Omar (SE): Draft risk acceptance (short): \"Under a specific combination of streaming and JSON-mode function calls our runtime could emit function-call arguments as a quoted string, causing strict validators to fail. We deployed a tenant-scoped sanitizer to unescape such values as a temporary mitigation and are shipping INF-9120, a runtime fix to emit structured arguments when json_mode is enabled. Control-plane logs are redacted by default; Dedicated supports per-tenant KMS and HSM-backed keys. The sanitizer is scoped to tenant trustbank-331 and will be removed after runtime patch verification.\"

Lena (AE): Sent to CISO, accepted. Closing POC blocker. Thanks all.
